# UI Design System: Solo Leveling ARISE / System Theme
- Color Palette: Deep black background (#0b0f19), Slate/Dark Blue cards (#111827), Neon Electric Blue accents (#00f3ff for system text/borders), Shadow Monarch Purple (#9333ea for rare items/alerts), and Crisp White text.
- Typography: Monospace or futuristic sci-fi fonts for data stats, clean sans-serif for body text.
- Component Style: Angular borders (clipped corners using CSS clip-path), glowing box-shadows, semi-transparent glassmorphism panels, and floating notification alerts mimicking the System's blue message windows.
